subject: colour scale for POSIXlt times in 0.9.2

messages.author: 9ff09e64da27eae3
messages.subject: colour scale for POSIXlt times in 0.9.2
parts:
Hello,

I just upgraded from ggplot2 0.9.1 to 0.9.2.1. The way POSIXlt times are mapped to colours has changed, and I don't know how to get back to the old behaviour.

0.9.1:
 The colour scale is a continuous gradient (dark to light blue).
 png : http://ubuntuone.com/1sUwIK5ttAW6wf471g9ZdI

0.9.2/0.9.2.1:
 The colour scale is discretized.
 png : http://ubuntuone.com/7BbACLrxL9oHvsOjF8FBSy

Is there a way to get back the gradient scale in 0.9.2.1? (I did try to search the changelog and the mailing list, to no avail. Pointers to previous discussions would of course be appreciated.)

Here is my code:

library(reshape)
library(ggplot2)

dat <- mutate(data.frame(x=seq(0,10,0.1)),
              y = sin(x),
              t = as.POSIXlt(sprintf("2012-07-18 20:%d:%f", as.integer(x), x)))

summary(dat)

ggplot.version <- sessionInfo("ggplot2")$otherPkgs$ggplot2$Version
cat("this is ggplot2 version", ggplot.version, "\n")

p <- ggplot(dat) + geom_point(aes(x=x, y=y, color=t))
ggsave(sprintf("time-color-%s.png", ggplot.version))

-- 
Ronan

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: colour scale for POSIXlt times in 0.9.2
parts:
Hi,

Not sure if this is the recommended way, but

library(lubridate)
ggplot(dat) + geom_point(aes(x=x, y=y, color=second(t)))

seems to work.

Best,
Ista
